title: campanula rumeliana subsp. chalcidica
intro: Campanula rumeliana subsp. chalcidica, commonly known as a wild bellflower, is a flowering plant species in the Campanulaceae family. This plant has been traditionally used for its health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to alleviate symptoms of anxiety and insomnia. The therapeutic actions of Campanula rumeliana subsp. chalcidica include its sedative, anxiolytic, and antispasmodic effects, which may help to promote relaxation and reduce muscle spasms. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
